top_signals.title: Iran Outlines Terms for Restoring Hormuz Shipping
top_signals.summary: Iran is preparing a list of conditions for reopening the Strait of Hormuz after mediators asked Tehran to set them out, said Mohsen Rezaei, secretary of Iran's Supreme National Security Council, adding that ending the regional war was among…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
